import bpy, os, json, shutil, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures/shipyard_painterly_20261111'
cap.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not (cap/'before_painterly.blend').exists(), 'Backup already exists; audit state before repeating'
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(cap/'before_painterly.blend'),copy=True)
shutil.copy2(root/'assets/coast/shipyard_combined.glb',cap/'before_painterly.glb')
craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'];exp=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Export']
mats={s.material for o in list(craft.objects)+list(exp.objects) for s in o.material_slots if s.material}
out=[]
for m in sorted(mats,key=lambda m:m.name):
 p=next((n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED'),None) if m.use_nodes else None
 out.append({'name':m.name,'users':m.users,'base':list(p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value) if p else list(m.diffuse_color),
 'roughness':p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value if p else m.roughness,
 'metallic':p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value if p else m.metallic,
 'images':[{'node':n.name,'image':n.image.name,'path':n.image.filepath,'size':list(n.image.size),'space':n.image.colorspace_settings.name} for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and n.image] if m.use_nodes else [],
 'links':[(l.from_node.name,l.from_socket.name,l.to_node.name,l.to_socket.name) for l in m.node_tree.links] if m.use_nodes else [],
 'normals':[(n.name,n.inputs['Strength'].default_value) for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='NORMAL_MAP'] if m.use_nodes else []})
report={'pid':os.getpid(),'file':bpy.data.filepath,'craft_objects':len(craft.objects),'export_objects':len(exp.objects),'materials':out,
'export':[{'name':o.name,'material':o.active_material.name if o.active_material else None,'vertices':len(o.data.vertices),'polys':len(o.data.polygons)} for o in exp.objects if o.type=='MESH'],
'pil':bool(importlib.util.find_spec('PIL'))}
(cap/'before_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps(report))
